repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: The agent engineering platform.
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
repos.summary_en: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

repos.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

repos.description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: The all-in-one AI productivity accelerator. On device and privacy first with no annoying setup or configration.
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
repos.summary_zh: Trilium Notes 是一款免费开源的跨平台笔记应用，支持构建大型个人知识库。其核心功能包括无限层级树状结构、富文本与 Markdown 编辑器、代码高亮、全文搜索、版本控制及多位置克隆笔记，适用于知识管理与结构化信息存储。
repos.summary_en: Trilium Notes is a free, open-source, cross-platform note-taking app focused on building large personal knowledge bases. It features hierarchical notes with cloning support, rich WYSIWYG editing (including math and code syntax highlighting), full-text search, versioning, and seamless navigation.

repos.description: Query Engine for AI Analytics: Build self-reasoning agents across all your live data
repos.summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
repos.summary_zh: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding, semantic retrieval, and context-aware answers using RAG paradigm.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款跨平台Markdown AI笔记软件，专注于通过AI将碎片化信息转化为结构化知识。核心功能包括智能语音转写、RAG知识库构建、MCP工具集成及自动化智能体处理，支持全平台同步且完全免费无广告，适用于高效记录与深度写作场景。
repos.summary_en: NoteGen is a cross-platform Markdown note-taking app that leverages AI to transform fragmented knowledge into structured notes. Key features include voice-to-text transcription, RAG-powered knowledge management, MCP tool integration, and automated AI agents. It offers free sync across all platforms with no ads, ideal for efficient recording and deep writing workflows.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: Private & local AI personal knowledge management app for high entropy people.
repos.summary_zh: Reor 是一款本地运行的 AI 个人知识管理应用，专为高信息密度人群设计。它基于 Ollama、Transformers.js 和 LanceDB 构建，支持自动关联笔记、语义搜索与 LLM 驱动的问答。所有数据本地存储，提供类 Obsidian 的 Markdown 编辑器，通过向量数据库实现智能内容检索与思维增强。
repos.summary_en: Reor is a private, local AI-powered personal knowledge management app for high-entropy individuals. Built on Ollama, Transformers.js, and LanceDB, it enables automatic note linking, semantic search, and LLM-based Q&A via RAG. All data stays local with an Obsidian-like markdown editor, offering intelligent context retrieval to augment thought.

repos.description: Make changes to FMHY
repos.summary_zh: FMHY 是一个聚合海量免费资源的互联网平台，涵盖软件、工具、学习资料等，提供结构化索引与社区推荐。项目通过 Wiki 维护内容，支持 Markdown/JSON API 备份，强调去中心化存储与社区协作，所有文件均托管于第三方，确保内容自由开放。
repos.summary_en: FMHY is the largest internet platform curating free resources like software, tools, and learning materials, offering structured indexes and community recommendations. It maintains content via a Wiki, supports Markdown/JSON API backups, emphasizes decentralized storage, and operates without hosting files, ensuring open and free access.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型和 RAG 技术的智能问数系统，支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），实现自然语言转 SQL 查询并生成可视化图表。具备开箱即用、安全可控、易于集成等优势，可嵌入 DataEase、Dify 等应用，支持细粒度权限管理与持续优化，越问越准。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an intelligent data querying system powered by LLMs and RAG, enabling conversational analytics (ChatBI) with natural language-to-SQL conversion and visualization. It offers plug-and-play deployment, secure workspace isolation, fine-grained permissions, and seamless integration into platforms like DataEase and Dify, continuously improving accuracy through user interactions.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: 中文langchain项目|小必应，Q.Talk，强聊，QiangTalk
repos.summary_zh: Chinese-LangChain 是基于 ChatGLM-6B 和 LangChain 的中文本地化智能问答系统，支持知识库检索与生成、多文档解析（PDF/DOCX/PPT）、互联网搜索及增量更新，提供 Gradio 交互界面，适用于垂直领域知识问答场景。
repos.summary_en: Chinese-LangChain is a localized Chinese LLM application built on ChatGLM-6B and LangChain, enabling knowledge retrieval, multi-format document parsing, web search, and incremental updates via a Gradio interface for domain-specific Q&A.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

repos.description: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论的个人知识库构建 Skill，支持多平台！
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的多平台个人知识库自动化系统，支持 PDF、网页、微信公众号、YouTube 等素材的智能提取与结构化整理。通过统一技能接口集成到 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等 AI 智能体，实现零配置初始化、双向链接 Wiki 生成、知识健康检查等功能，输出 Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 格式知识库。
repos.summary_en: A multi-platform personal knowledge base automation system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology. Integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to automatically extract and structure content from PDFs, web articles, WeChat, YouTube, and more into a bidirectional linked wiki. Features zero-config setup, intelligent routing, batch processing, and outputs Obsidian-compatible markdown.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: Lumina Note - A modern Markdown note-taking app with live preview, bidirectional links, and AI assistant
repos.summary_zh: Lumina Note 是一款本地优先的 AI 笔记应用，支持 Markdown 实时预览、双向链接（WikiLinks）和知识图谱可视化。集成多模态 AI 助手（Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex），提供本地语义检索（RAG）功能，确保数据完全掌控于用户手中。
repos.summary_en: Lumina Note is a local-first AI note-taking app featuring live Markdown preview, bidirectional links, and knowledge graph visualization. It integrates multimodal AI assistants (Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex) with local RAG retrieval, ensuring full data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: 网站
repos.summary_zh: 开源阅读官网基于 Docusaurus 2 构建，提供文档、博客和下载功能，支持 Markdown 内容创作，便于用户贡献阅读APP相关资源，提升社区知识共享效率。
repos.summary_en: The open-source reading official website is built with Docusaurus 2, featuring documentation, blogs, and downloads. It supports Markdown-based content contributions for the reading app, enhancing community knowledge sharing.

repos.description: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
repos.summary_zh: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

repos.description: 基于 [Karpathy llm-wiki]方法论，利用 AI 持续构建和维护你的个人知识库。支持从多种素材源（网页、推特、公众号、小红书、知乎、YouTube、PDF、本地文件）自动整理为结构化的 wiki，并通过 Quartz 发布为静态wiki知识库网站。 并通过 claude_agent_sdk 调用 claude agent 使用 llm-wiki ,提供api接口对外访问服务 。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的个人 AI 知识库系统，支持从网页、社交媒体、PDF 等多元素材源自动提取并结构化生成 wiki 内容，通过 Quartz 发布为静态网站，并利用 Claude Agent SDK 提供 API 服务，实现端到端的智能知识管理与检索增强生成（RAG）。
repos.summary_en: A personal AI knowledge base system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology, enabling automated ingestion and structuring of content from diverse sources (web, social media, PDFs) into a wiki format. It publishes knowledge via Quartz as a static site and exposes capabilities through the Claude Agent SDK with RESTful APIs for agentic RAG applications.

repos.description: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级“从想法到结构化图谱”的工作台：输入一个核心想法，应用会把它扩展为可浏览的知识图谱（模块/子模块）。每个节点支持继续追问扩展、深挖详情，以及可选的配图生成。
repos.summary_zh: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级‘从想法到结构化图谱’工作台，支持输入核心概念自动生成可交互知识图谱。具备AI驱动发散扩展、深度内容挖掘、视觉配图生成、沉浸式演示模式等功能，采用Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core技术栈，实现本地优先的零平台锁定体验。
repos.summary_en: ThinkFlow AI is a lightweight 'idea-to-structured-graph' workspace that transforms core concepts into interactive knowledge graphs. Features AI-driven divergence expansion, deep content mining, visual image generation, immersive presentation mode, and local-first architecture with zero platform lock-in. Built with Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core stack.

repos.description: A battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents that need to remember across sessions.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Memory Architecture 是一套经过实战验证的 AI Agent 长期记忆系统，解决跨会话失忆问题。采用双层文件架构（热缓存 MEMORY.md + 深度存储 memory/），结合确定性查找与语义搜索检索协议，通过 Supersede 机制追踪事实演变，并引入程序职员模式自动沉淀知识。所有数据以 Markdown+JSON 格式存储，Git 友好且透明可控，确保在嵌入服务不可用时仍具备 90% 日常场景的零依赖检索能力。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Memory Architecture is a battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents requiring cross-session recall. It features a hot cache (MEMORY.md) and deep storage (memory/) with deterministic lookup and semantic search protocols, Supersede mechanism for fact evolution tracking, and a 'program clerk' process for automated knowledge proposal with human review. Built on Git-friendly Markdown/JSON, it maintains 90% zero-dependency functionality even when embedding services fail.

repos.description: 一个AI写作平台
repos.summary_zh: do-write 是一个基于 Java 和 Spring AI 的 AI 驱动小说创作平台，提供从世界观构建、角色设计到大纲规划和章节生成的全流程智能写作向导。核心亮点包括 RAG 增强的上下文感知写作、ChromaDB 故事记忆系统保持剧情连贯性，支持 OpenAI/Ollama/DashScope 等多模型接入，并具备 Docker 一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Do-Write is an AI-powered novel writing platform built with Java and Spring AI, offering end-to-end creative guidance from world-building to chapter generation. Key features include RAG-enhanced contextual writing, ChromaDB-based story memory for plot continuity, multi-model support (OpenAI/Ollama/DashScope), and Docker Compose deployment. The system combines intelligent prompts with vectorized narrative recall.
